response.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), status_averages AS (SELECT rfistat AS status, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rfistat), qualifying AS (SELECT sa.status, sa.avg_modindex, o.overall_avg FROM status_averages sa CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE sa.avg_modindex > o.overall_avg) SELECT status, avg_modindex, avg_modindex - overall_avg AS amount_above_average, avg_modindex - AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS difference_from_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying;
